Switch statements can be used to work around this. However, in complicated use-cases this becomes cumbersome. My heightmap example is relatively simple; using this same technique for sampling a fragment color based on a 4-texture splatmap would be more than four times as long.

This GitHub search shows some more examples of this common pattern which could be avoided with this qualifier (though I couldn't find any for Godot specifically): https://github.com/search?q=texture%28u_Textures%5B9%5D&type=code

title: Add support for non-uniform indexing qualifier (nonuniformEXT() in GLSL) in shaders
